svg.title: BitNote
svg.desc: BitNote: Notion-style notebooks with a built-in AI tutor. Syllabus & week-by-week roadmap from one goal. Recall quizzes with AI grading & mastery tracking. BitBuddy: in-cell AI chat and one-click summaries. Local Ollama or hosted Gemini via one env var. Built with FastAPI, Ollama, SQLite, Firebase, Tailwind.
